name: Johnson Electric Holdings Limited
summary: Johnson Electric Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells motion systems the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the People's Republic of China. The company offers AC motors; actuators (automotive); blowers; cargo bikes; DC motors; EC motors (brushless); eDrives; EV chargers; flat flexible cable (FFC); flex circuits and microelectronics; gearmotors and gearboxes; haptic motion products; motorized drive rollers; piezo motors and subsystems; piezo stages; powder metal components; pumps and valves; solenoids; starters; steerable wheel; and stepper motors, as well as switches and relays.
